svg.text: Pipeline Copilot · Docker container on the Oracle Cloud VM
React (Vite): live tool steps, diagnosis card, fix card with Approve / Reject, 3D robot (Blender GLB, React Three Fiber)
FastAPI streams every step over Server-Sent Events; POST /api/threads/{id}/decision resumes a paused run
runtime.py: starts the MCP servers; SQLite checkpointer saves state after every node, so a run can pause for approval and resume
monitor: 30-min checks incl. memory / CPU / disk, resource history, alerts on new failures (never approves fixes)
① – ⑤ investigate · ⑥ – 10 fix with your approval
tool calls · MCP over stdio (② and ⑨)
run when docs change: split by
+ a Docker proxy that can only restart
read-only, no writes to data or catalog
